name: s4-g100-preregistration
status: committed BEFORE the primary experiment was run; see git history
research_question: Can a controlled aperture plus ordered exploratory/verification operations reveal useful hidden structure beyond deterministic, static-ensemble and equal-entropy stochastic controls, while preserving round-trip and gauge stability under matched resource budgets?

declared_expectation.statement: On the tuning partition the chamber beat the deterministic baseline on the SMALL nerve only (E=13, 23.4% of the candidate space sampled: C4 0.682 vs C0 0.599) and lost on the medium and large nerves (E=24: C0 0.659 vs best chamber 0.558; E=36: C0 0.705 vs best chamber 0.558).
declared_expectation.prediction: S4-G100 will FAIL gate 1 on the held-out families, because the chamber's advantage appears only where sampling is already near-exhaustive. The advantage is expected to be an artifact of budget-to-search-space ratio rather than of aperture or ordering.
declared_expectation.why_this_is_recorded: Preregistering the expected NEGATIVE result removes the option of presenting a failure as a surprise or a success as a confirmation. If the chamber does win on held-out families, that is now a genuine surprise and is worth more than it would have been.
declared_expectation.why_the_regime_was_not_narrowed: Preregistering only the small nerve, where the chamber wins, would be post-hoc regime selection -- the same defect falsifier F6 names for the perturbation seeds. All three scales are held-out and gated together.

host.primary_representation: real_matrix -- NOT quaternionic and NOT octonionic, per the S3 governing constraints
host.task: localise hidden defective overlaps from cycle holonomy alone; no overlap is locally anomalous by construction

tuning.used_for: objective design, exploration floor, aperture gain; NOT reported as a result

held_out_by_family.spec: ring_of_worldlets(16, chords=((i,i+8) for i in range(8)))
ring_of_worldlets(24, chords=((i,i+12) for i in range(12)))
random connected nerve, V=12, E=20, spanning tree plus random chords
4x4 grid graph with wraparound in one direction

partitions.note: ring_small shares its spec with the tuning family but NOT its seeds; the other four families were never touched during development.

conditions.C0: deterministic S3 sheaf localiser (cycle holonomy + equal blame spreading)
conditions.C1: equal-entropy random perturbation of the observed transitions, then C0
conditions.C2: static candidate ensemble, fixed aperture, no verify->explore feedback
conditions.C3: adaptive aperture, no ordered Emperor-Empress flow
conditions.C6: C4 with each of the three fixed structured perturbation fields
conditions.C7: C4 with matched-spectrum surrogate fields (sign-randomised, identical power spectrum)
conditions.C8: the best apparent condition under all ten representation and gauge attacks

parity.note_on_evaluations: identical for every chamber condition; the loop halts when spent, so a wider aperture buys fewer steps rather than more compute
parity.instrument_cost_separate: the order-defect probe is charged to an instrument ledger and reported separately, because it measures the chamber rather than being part of it
parity.parameter_asymmetry_declared: C4 and C5 carry one more parameter (the exploration floor) than C2 and C3. If the ordered conditions win by a margin comparable to what one parameter buys, the ordered interpretation is NOT supported.
parity.data_access: every condition sees the same nerve, the same cycle basis and the same transitions
parity.tuning_budget: zero for all held-out runs; no per-instance or per-family tuning is permitted

primary_effect_region.name: DeltaY
primary_effect_region.type: typed effect region evaluated by DOMINANCE, never by a weighted score
primary_effect_region.rationale: RET-R3-SCALAR_PROMOTION retired a weighted gate in this repository because one number let a large gain on a cheap axis pay for a loss on an expensive one

secondary_reporting.brier: full distribution, not only the mean
secondary_reporting.raw_values: all metrics reported raw before normalisation or clipping
secondary_reporting.order_defect: reported as an observable; a nonzero value is NOT evidence for the ordered interpretation

representation_attacks: equivalent candidate encoding (support set vs indicator vector)
fixed structured seeds replaced by matched-spectrum surrogates
kill_conditions: F1 static ensemble C2 matches the complete effect region
F2 equal-entropy random perturbation C1 or matched surrogate C7 matches it
F3 C4 does not outperform both C3 and C5 by at least +0.01 held-out AUROC
F4 the effect disappears on held-out nerve families
F5 the effect depends materially on labels, cycle basis, gauge or encoding
F6 the structured seeds work only under post-hoc selection
F7 an ordinary confidence margin predicts useful susceptibility as well as the aperture observables
F9 raw metrics reveal clipping, leakage or tautological validation

amendment_policy.permitted: exactly one amendment, before any primary run, and only for a genuine unit incompatibility
amendment_policy.forbidden: any amendment after S4 primary results are observed

f7_operationalisation.confidence_margin_baseline: gap between the top-scoring and second-scoring overlap under C0, normalised by the score range
f7_operationalisation.test: if this ordinary margin predicts which instances the chamber helps on as well as the aperture susceptibility signal does, HYP-S4-FERTILE_APERTURE gains nothing from the aperture construction
f7_operationalisation.comparison: Spearman correlation with per-instance delta_auroc, both reported with bootstrap intervals

stop_condition: no new fauna, higher Cayley-Dickson levels, physical quantum claims, morphogenesis or visualization layers until S4-G100 crosses its gate or is retired. A negative result is a valid completion.
